slides.title: Balanced accuracy: 0.50 score only, 0.75 fact file
slides.interpretation: Fact file 95% CI 0.50 to 1.0, McNemar p = 0.125: no interval excludes 0.5. It rejected 12 of 12 perturbed Boltz-2 poses and valid high-strain DiffDock-L poses.
slides.figure_alt_text: Balanced accuracy by arm with 95% intervals, and pooled confusion matrices
slides.notes: FtsE fact-file values in all three runs predate the superposition fix (commit de35af7).
